evidence: THREE INDEPENDENT LINES CONVERGE ON THE SAME 60-ENTRY MAPPING. (1) PHONETIC-VALUE DERIVATION. Both published CSUR charts establish that the certh names are phonetic values rather than letter-names, and that the ordering follows Appendix E together with its Eregion and Moria extensions. Aligning those names in order against this archive's own Daeron/Moria/Erebor value table yields a unique monotonic fit, and 58 of 60 agree with the value the archive already recorded. (2) GLYPH-SHAPE ALIGNMENT, independent of names. The archive's 60 drawn certh were rasterised against all 128 font glyphs and aligned monotonically: score 38.79 against 23.20 for the naive hypothesis, and beaten by 0 of 20,000 random monotonic alignments. (3) KEYBOARD STRUCTURE, recovered from the chart's text layer, which prints each codepoint's legacy source-font key. Those keys resolve to four rows of fifteen -- 4 x 15 = 60 exactly -- with the six leftover slots on overflow shifted keys that interrupt otherwise unbroken runs, and all six are named as variants rather than as numbered cirth. (4) A FOURTH LINE FOUND LATER, from a source the derivation never touched: Glaemscrafu's own charset declares 60 numbered certh aliases against a legacy 8-bit layout, and 59 of those 60 bytes fall exactly where the keyboard structure above predicts.
caveats: 1) NOT A REGISTRY STATEMENT. This mapping is DERIVED by three agreeing independent methods, not quoted from any source. 2) THE SIMPLE HYPOTHESIS IS FALSE. certh n = U+E07F+n holds only for certh 1-38. From certh 39 the registry interleaves six unnumbered variants, so the offset grows: +1 at certh 39, +2 at 46, +3 at 52, +4 at 53, +5 at 56, +6 at 57-60. certh 60 is U+E0C1, not U+E0BB. 3) certh 54 is the one name/value disagreement: CSUR names U+E0B9 'CIRTH LETTER H' where the archive records the Moria/Erebor value s. This is the known s~h ambiguity of the certh 34/54 pair. Shape matching independently places certh 54 at U+E0B9 with correlation 0.889, so the placement is not in doubt; only Everson's choice of name is. 4) certh 43: the archive records no Daeron value and gives Erebor z, while CSUR names U+E0AB 'UU' (long u). Placement rests on shape (0.671) and on both neighbours being fixed. 5) Shape evidence is weak for certh 39, 55, 56 and 59 (small or sparse glyphs); those rest mainly on the phonetic names and the keyboard structure, both unambiguous for them (I, schwa, schwa, MODIFIER LETTER H). 6) The four schwa slots U+E0BA..U+E0BD: the two named KHUZDUL are taken as certh 55 and 56, the two named SHORT as unnumbered halved forms. This follows the naming convention (KHUZDUL marks a certh with a Khuzdul value, used consistently at E0A2/E0A4/E0A8/E0A9/E0B8/E0BE/E0BF, all numbered cirth) and the keyboard layout (the SHORT pair sits on overflow keys > and ?). This is the least directly corroborated part of the mapping. 7) ArdaCSUR is Unifont-derived, so line (2) tests the archive's drawings against Unifont's reading of the CSUR chart, not against the chart itself: independent of the NAMES, but not of the CSUR project. 8) The two registries diverge ABOVE U+E0C1 (KreativeKorp inserts CIRTH LETTER LL at U+E0CE, shifting later positions, and places punctuation at U+E0E7..U+E0EB where Evertype has U+E0E5..U+E0EC plus three combining marks). This does not touch the numbered range.
note: DERIVED, not quoted: no source states 'certh N = U+XXXX' and neither published chart mentions Appendix E's numbering. Three methods agree -- phonetic names against the archive's own value table, a name-INDEPENDENT glyph-shape alignment beaten by 0 of 20,000 random monotonic alignments, and a keyboard layout that resolves to four rows of fifteen. The naive hypothesis certh N = U+E07F+N is FALSE for 22 of the 60.
evidence_note: Written as the ARCHIVE'S OWN SENTENCES. quoted_check verifies every quoted span against corpus/, and the first version quoted two sentences from an external chart that is not in the corpus and is not ours to reproduce. A quotation the archive cannot verify is exactly what that guard exists to catch; it was right to catch mine. What the charts ESTABLISH is filed; what they SAY is not reproduced -- the same line gen_amanye.py draws.
